description: Returns a household's 2027 ACA marketplace position from its state, the ages on the plan, household size and income: the county's benchmark (second-lowest-cost silver) premium from CMS's plan-year-2027 files for the HealthCare.gov states, or a given one; the poverty line that sets 2027 credits (2026 HHS guidelines) and the income as a percentage of it; the 400% cliff income and the headroom below it or the amount over it; and whether the income is below the Medicaid line of an expansion state or below the poverty line. The premium tax credit itself is not figured. Not tax advice.

ages.description: The ages of the people on the marketplace plan. Ages 21-64 are priced; 65 and over (Medicare) and under 21 are not.

benchmark_monthly.description: The household's own monthly benchmark (second-lowest-cost silver) premium for the people on the plan, from healthcare.gov or the state's marketplace. Default: the county's CMS figure when county is given; stated in the result.

county.description: The county (name, e.g. Miami-Dade, or 5-digit FIPS code) whose CMS plan-year-2027 benchmark premium is read; published for the HealthCare.gov states. Default: none, stated in the result.

coverage_year.description: The coverage year: 2027 (the CMS county benchmark, the poverty line, the 400% cliff and the headroom, from published data).

household_size.description: Tax family size for the poverty line (the filer, a spouse on a joint return, dependents). Default: the number of ages given, stated in the result.

income.description: The household's modified AGI for the credit: AGI plus tax-exempt interest plus the Social Security not taxed, for the coverage year.

state.description: Two-letter state of residence, or DC.

name: aca_premium_tax_credit
title: 2027 ACA marketplace benchmark, poverty line and the 400% cliff
